implementation: uncommitted natural speech completion barrier, SDK 0.0.18, main TTS profile
privacy: No tokens, credentials, conversational text or audio. IDs, lengths, timing and numerical PCM energy only.
sampleSelection: Every RMS > 0.001 sample plus initial and changed muted/paused/volume states per participant. Quiet unchanged samples omitted; original sample counts retained. No RMS rounding. vad_score events omitted. Reconstruct sample objects to replay acoustic-evidence.mjs; stored classifications are not changed.
